title: Set Of 2 Vintage Six Flags Looney Tunes Bugs Bunny Plastic Bottles Rare 15” 1996
descriptionText:
Set of 2. Excellent condition. 

This rare set of vintage Six Flags plastic bottles features the beloved Looney Tunes character, Bugs Bunny. The round cups are perfect for enjoying hot or cold beverages and come with a fun 3D design. The set includes a coffee cup and coffee mug, both featuring the iconic character in multicolor. 

The bottles are from 1996 and are part of the Warner Brothers Six Flags collection. They are not signed, but are a great addition to any cartoon or TV character collection. The cups are perfect for fans of The Looney Tunes and are a unique piece of animation merchandise.
